empirical_ranges.application: forecast + lower_offset_pp, forecast + upper_offset_pp; match m/m or y/y units

12.reason: Fewer than 20 finite errors with released outcomes

empirical_ranges.receipt_policy: Detailed release calendar; date-only usable after UTC date end; missing dates after following month end
empirical_ranges.limitations: Fixed central 80% empirical historical-error offsets (actual minus forecast), not calibrated prospective probabilities or confidence intervals for a mean. Historical release-eve nowcasts differ from the current mid-month decision clock. Overlapping path errors are dependent. Outcomes and reconstructed inputs use the retained latest vintage; receipt gating does not recreate historical data vintages.

sample.window: All finite common-support pre-origin observations of the same calendar month

seasonal.definition: Historical arithmetic mean of NSA component m/m, multiplied by recorded origin weights; wedge = headline minus the five weighted components at those same weights

exact_model_seasonal_terms.reason: Fitted seasonal coefficients were not archived in the adapter; no model refit is performed

seasonal.limitations: Descriptive seasonal normal, not an exact model decomposition or causal attribution. Negative NSA September core inflation is not automatically disinflation. The deviation also contains model, pipeline and accounting effects. Historical weights are held at the recorded current values for this benchmark.

model_disagreement.definition: Historical HARD_BASE/HARD_HALF/HARD_FULL max-minus-min m/m spread, not an error range, confidence interval or model promotion
model_disagreement.scope: Matured h0 origins also included in the empirical-error context; fresh core-path sensitivities are supplied separately by the parent

current.definition: Recorded HARD_BASE/HARD_HALF/HARD_FULL challenger disagreement, not uncertainty or an error band; no model promotion

base_effect_definition: Exact removal-then-add: first divide by the outgoing gross monthly factor, then multiply by the incoming factor; effects are percentage points, not log points

sources.support_definition: All 90 R31C HARD_BASE origins; path h1..h12 only scored=True from the accepted R31B file
sources.truth_definition: h0: comparison.csv actual, matched to run_C123 HARD_BASE; path: actual_previous minus yy_lane, never actual_bbg
sources.readiness_note: Six archived December rows have ready=False. All remain in the fixed 90-origin historical scoring roster; no readiness-based selection is applied.

limitations: Research explanation sidecar. No data pull, fit, backtest, model selection, promotion, or calibrated prospective probability is performed.
